comment: Shared by crates/skidpad-core/tests/kinematics_tests.rs and packages/core/test/kinematics.test.ts so the Rust and TypeScript validators give the same messages (ADR-0025). Each case patches the default definition's axle `axle`: `axleFields` onto the axle, `suspensionFields` onto its suspension. `errors` are every kinematics message expected, in order.

cases.name: too few points
errors: axles[0] (front).suspension.kinematics.toeDeg must have between 2 and 16 points (got 1)

cases.name: too many points
errors: axles[1] (rear).suspension.kinematics.antiDrive must have between 2 and 16 points (got 17)

cases.name: travel not increasing
errors: axles[0] (front).suspension.kinematics.camberDeg travel must be strictly increasing (point 2 at 0 m follows 0 m)

cases.name: not zero at zero travel
errors: axles[0] (front).suspension.kinematics.rollCenterHeight must pass through zero at zero travel (got 0.2); it is an offset from the static value

cases.name: total beyond the bound
errors: axles[1] (rear).suspension.kinematics.antiBrake plus the static value reaches 2.25 at 0.1 m of travel, beyond ±2

cases.name: toe beyond ten degrees
errors: axles[0] (front).suspension.kinematics.toeDeg plus the static value reaches -10.5 at -0.1 m of travel, beyond ±10

cases.name: wheel angles on a solid axle
errors: axles[1] (rear).suspension.kinematics.toeDeg is not allowed on a solid axle; the beam sets the wheel angles (ADR-0016)
axles[1] (rear).suspension.kinematics.camberDeg is not allowed on a solid axle; the beam sets the wheel angles (ADR-0016)
